Which SD-900 units could replace SD9-K-0:
SELECT d.serial, d.condition, s.site_name, r.reservation_id, c.customer_name AS reserved_for,
r.needed_by_date, p.first_name AS reservation_owner
FROM drive_units d
JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = 'KOL-PL2' AND d.model = m.required_model
JOIN sites s ON s.site_id = d.site_id
LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.serial = d.serial AND r.status = 'active'
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
LEFT JOIN people p ON p.person_id = r.owner_person_id
WHERE d.status = 'in_stock';
Who is the account owner for Kolvo AB?:
SELECT c.customer_name, p.first_name, p.role
FROM account_owners a
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
JOIN people p ON p.person_id = a.owner_person_id
WHERE c.customer_name = 'Kolvo AB';
Which units are reserved, for whom, and:
SELECT r.reservation_id, r.serial, c.customer_name, r.machine_id, r.needed_by_date, p.first_name AS owner
FROM reservations r
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
JOIN people p ON p.person_id = r.owner_person_id
WHERE r.status = 'active';
